## Purpose
Assign tidal stage to Storm Wali discrete water-quality samples and characterize how Storm Wali disrupted the tidal dynamics of He"eia Fishpond (HFP).

## 0. Setup
```{r setup, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(lunar)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)

# ---- File paths (adjust per project) -----------------------------------------
input_path  <- "/Users/becca/Documents/current projects/Manuscript Storm Wali/data/raw"
output_path <- "/Users/becca/Documents/current projects/Manuscript Storm Wali/data/processed/hydrometeorology/tides"
figure_path <- "/Users/becca/Documents/current projects/Manuscript Storm Wali/output/figure_supp1_tidal_dynamics"

path_samples  <- file.path(input_path, "../processed/physicochemistry/sample_data.csv")
path_ctd      <- file.path(output_path, "../ctd_extracted_data/ctd_extracted_pressure.csv")

# NOAA observed (verified) 6-min water levels
path_obs_jun  <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_june.csv")
path_obs_jul  <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_july.csv")
path_obs_aug  <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_tides_august.csv")

# NOAA harmonic predictions (High/Low only) — used for major/minor classification
path_tide_jun <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_predictions_june.txt")
path_tide_jul <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_predictions_july.txt")
path_tide_aug <- file.path(input_path, "hydrometeorology/tides/noaa_mokh1_predictions_august.txt")

# ---- Storm Wali date window (HST) -------------------------------------------
# Storm onset Jul 20; impacts persist through Jul 23.
STORM_START <- ymd("2014-07-20", tz = "Pacific/Honolulu")
STORM_END   <- ymd("2014-07-23", tz = "Pacific/Honolulu")   # Jul 20-22 = 3 full calendar days; all rainfall + 1 day hydrological lag

# Visualization-only: storm shading extends back to broader rainfall onset on
# Oahu (~18:00 HST Jul 19, per UH meteorological records). Used in Figure S1
# storm-shading rectangles only; analytical period boundaries use STORM_START
# / STORM_END above.
STORM_SHADING_START <- ymd_hms("2014-07-19 18:00:00", tz = "Pacific/Honolulu")
STORM_SHADING_END   <- STORM_END
```

## 1. Load & tidy sample data
```{r load-samples}
samples_raw <- read_csv(path_samples, show_col_types = FALSE)

sampling_events <- samples_raw %>%
  select(Date, Field_Time_Start, Field_Time_Finish) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    Date_parsed = suppressWarnings(ymd(Date)),

    # Coerce time columns to "HH:MM" strings
    time_start_chr  = str_extract(as.character(Field_Time_Start),  "^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}"),
    time_finish_chr = str_extract(as.character(Field_Time_Finish), "^\\d{1,2}:\\d{2}"),

    # POSIXct datetimes in HST
    start_dt = ymd_hm(paste(format(Date_parsed, "%Y-%m-%d"), time_start_chr),
                       tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"),
    finish_dt = case_when(
      !is.na(time_finish_chr) ~
        ymd_hm(paste(format(Date_parsed, "%Y-%m-%d"), time_finish_chr),
               tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"),
      TRUE ~ NA_POSIXct_
    ),

    duration_h = as.numeric(difftime(finish_dt, start_dt, units = "hours")),

    # Window imputation: missing finish OR duration > 3 h → cap at 1.5 h
    window_flag = case_when(
      is.na(finish_dt) ~ "imputed_no_finish",
      duration_h > 3   ~ "imputed_long_duration",
      TRUE             ~ "observed"
    ),
    assess_end_dt = case_when(
      window_flag != "observed" ~ start_dt + dminutes(90),
      TRUE                      ~ finish_dt
    ),
    midpoint_dt = start_dt + (assess_end_dt - start_dt) / 2
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date_parsed))

stopifnot(nrow(sampling_events) > 0)

message("=== Sampling Events ===")
print(
  sampling_events %>%
    select(Date, Field_Time_Start, Field_Time_Finish, window_flag,
           start_dt, assess_end_dt, midpoint_dt),
  n = 20
)
```

## 2. Load NOAA verified 6-min water levels & detect High/Low extrema
```{r load-noaa-obs}
# 2a. Parse verified water levels ---------------------------------------------
# read_csv auto-parses Date as <date> and Time (LST) as <time> (hms);
# combine directly rather than string-pasting.
parse_noaa_obs <- function(filepath) {
  raw <- read_csv(filepath, show_col_types = FALSE)

  message(sprintf("  %s — %d cols (%d rows): %s",
                  basename(filepath), ncol(raw), nrow(raw),
                  paste(names(raw), collapse = ", ")))

  # Standardise column names via partial match
  cnames <- tolower(names(raw))
  date_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "^date")][1]
  time_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "time")][1]
  pred_col     <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "predict")][1]
  verified_col <- names(raw)[str_detect(cnames, "verif")][1]

  raw %>%
    rename(date_val    = !!date_col,
           time_val    = !!time_col,
           pred_m     = !!pred_col,
           verified_m = !!verified_col) %>%
    mutate(
      # Combine: force date to Date class, force time to seconds-since-midnight
      date_clean = as.Date(date_val),
      time_secs  = as.numeric(hms::as_hms(time_val)),  # seconds since midnight

      # Build POSIXct = midnight HST + seconds offset
      datetime = as.POSIXct(as.numeric(as.POSIXct(date_clean,
                                                    tz = "Pacific/Honolulu")) +
                              time_secs,
                            origin = "1970-01-01",
                            tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"),

      pred_m     = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(pred_m)),
      verified_m = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(verified_m))
    ) %>%
    select(datetime, pred_m, verified_m) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime), !is.na(verified_m))
}

noaa_obs <- bind_rows(
  parse_noaa_obs(path_obs_jun),
  parse_noaa_obs(path_obs_jul),
  parse_noaa_obs(path_obs_aug)
) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  distinct()

message(sprintf("\nNOAA observed water levels: %d rows  (%s to %s)",
                nrow(noaa_obs),
                format(min(noaa_obs$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d"),
                format(max(noaa_obs$datetime), "%Y-%m-%d")))
```


```{r detect-noaa-extrema}
# 2b. Detect High/Low extrema from verified signal ----------------------------
# Hawaii tidal period ~12.4 h; half-window of 3 h (180 min) separates
# successive highs/lows while avoiding false detections.

EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN <- 220L

detect_extrema <- function(obs_df, half_window_min = EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN) {
  hw <- dminutes(half_window_min)

  candidates <- obs_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_high = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- obs_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        verified_m[i] == max(win$verified_m, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      is_low = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- obs_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        verified_m[i] == min(win$verified_m, na.rm = TRUE)
      })
    ) %>%
    filter(is_high | is_low) %>%
    mutate(tide_type = case_when(
      is_high & !is_low ~ "H",
      is_low & !is_high ~ "L",
      # Tie: both high and low in the same window (flat water) — skip
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(tide_type))

  # Collapse duplicate detections (same extremum at adjacent 6-min steps)
  candidates %>%
    arrange(datetime) %>%
    mutate(type_run = cumsum(tide_type != lag(tide_type, default = ""))) %>%
    group_by(type_run) %>%
    slice(
      if (first(tide_type) == "H") which.max(verified_m)
      else which.min(verified_m)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(datetime, verified_m, pred_m, tide_type) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

message("Detecting tidal extrema from verified water levels (this may take ~30 s)...")
stopifnot(nrow(noaa_obs) > 0)
tides_noaa <- detect_extrema(noaa_obs)

message(sprintf("Detected %d tidal extrema from verified signal", nrow(tides_noaa)))
print(head(tides_noaa, 10))
```

```{r load-harmonic-predictions}
# 2c. Load NOAA harmonic H/L predictions for major/minor classification --------
parse_noaa_hl <- function(filepath) {
  raw <- suppressWarnings(
    read.table(filepath, header = FALSE, skip = 14, sep = "\t",
               fill = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  
  # Select only columns with data (skip empty columns from double-tabs)
  raw <- raw[, colSums(raw != "" & !is.na(raw)) > 0]
  names(raw) <- c("Date", "Day", "Time", "Pred", "HighLow")
  
  message(sprintf("  %s — %d rows", basename(filepath), nrow(raw)))
  
  raw %>%
    filter(nchar(Date) > 0, !is.na(Pred)) %>%
    mutate(
      datetime  = ymd_hm(paste(Date, Time), tz = "Pacific/Honolulu"),
      pred_m   = as.numeric(Pred),
      tide_type = trimws(HighLow)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(datetime)) %>%
    select(datetime, pred_m, tide_type) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

harmonic_hl <- bind_rows(
  parse_noaa_hl(path_tide_jun),
  parse_noaa_hl(path_tide_jul),
  parse_noaa_hl(path_tide_aug)
) %>% arrange(datetime)

# Classify major/minor: compare each extremum to the next same-type extremum
harmonic_hl <- harmonic_hl %>%
  group_by(tide_type) %>%
  mutate(
    next_pred = lead(pred_m),
    constituent = case_when(
      tide_type == "H" & pred_m >= next_pred ~ "Major",
      tide_type == "H" & pred_m <  next_pred ~ "Minor",
      tide_type == "L" & pred_m <= next_pred ~ "Major",
      tide_type == "L" & pred_m >  next_pred ~ "Minor",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(constituent = ifelse(is.na(constituent), lag(constituent), constituent)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(datetime, pred_m, tide_type, constituent) %>%
  arrange(datetime)

message(sprintf("\nLoaded %d harmonic H/L predictions", nrow(harmonic_hl)))
print(harmonic_hl %>% count(tide_type, constituent))
```

## 4. Extract local tidal extrema from CTD within NOAA-guided windows
```{r extract-local-extrema}
# Search window around each NOAA-detected extremum.
# Observed fishpond lags are ~40–90 min; 180 min post-NOAA provides buffer.
# Fishpond should never physically lead the open-ocean NOAA gauge, so
# SEARCH_BEFORE_MIN = 0.  Observed lags may reach ~180 min; 180 min
# provides ample buffer for spring/king tide conditions.
SEARCH_BEFORE_MIN <- 0L
SEARCH_AFTER_MAX  <- 180L

find_local_extremum <- function(noaa_time, noaa_type, ctd_data, obs_data) {
  win <- ctd_data %>%
    filter(datetime >= noaa_time - dminutes(SEARCH_BEFORE_MIN),
           datetime <= noaa_time + dminutes(SEARCH_AFTER_MAX))
  if (nrow(win) < 3) {
    return(list(local_dt = NA, local_p = NA, lag_min = NA,
                noaa_obs_m = NA, noaa_pred_m = NA))
  }

  idx <- if (noaa_type == "H") which.max(win$pressure) else which.min(win$pressure)
  local_time <- win$datetime[idx]

  # Nearest 6-min NOAA observation at the CTD extremum time
  noaa_near <- obs_data %>%
    filter(abs(as.numeric(difftime(datetime, local_time, units = "mins"))) <= 6) %>%
    slice_min(abs(as.numeric(difftime(datetime, local_time, units = "mins"))),
              n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)

  list(
    local_dt     = local_time,
    local_p      = win$pressure[idx],
    lag_min      = as.numeric(difftime(local_time, noaa_time, units = "mins")),
    noaa_obs_m  = if (nrow(noaa_near) > 0) noaa_near$verified_m else NA_real_,
    noaa_pred_m = if (nrow(noaa_near) > 0) noaa_near$pred_m     else NA_real_
  )
}

# Restrict NOAA events to dates surrounding sampling (±1 day)
sample_date_range <- seq(
  min(sampling_events$Date_parsed, na.rm = TRUE) - 1,
  max(sampling_events$Date_parsed, na.rm = TRUE) + 1,
  by = "day"
)

noaa_subset <- tides_noaa %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) %in% sample_date_range)

local_extrema <- noaa_subset %>%
  rename(noaa_dt          = datetime,
         noaa_verified_m = verified_m,
         noaa_pred_hl_m  = pred_m,
         noaa_type        = tide_type) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    extr         = list(find_local_extremum(noaa_dt, noaa_type, ctd, noaa_obs)),
    local_dt     = extr[["local_dt"]],
    local_p      = extr[["local_p"]],
    lag_min      = extr[["lag_min"]],
    noaa_obs_m  = extr[["noaa_obs_m"]],
    noaa_pred_m = extr[["noaa_pred_m"]]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-extr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(local_dt)) %>%
  arrange(local_dt)

message(sprintf("\nLocal CTD extrema: %d events", nrow(local_extrema)))
print(local_extrema %>%
        select(noaa_dt, noaa_type, noaa_verified_m, local_dt, local_p,
               lag_min, noaa_obs_m))
```

## 5. Assign tidal stage to each sampling event
```{r assign-tidal-stage}
STAGE_WINDOW_MIN <- 30L

assign_tidal_stage <- function(query_time, extrema_df) {
  if (is.na(query_time)) return(NA_character_)
  if (nrow(extrema_df) == 0) return("Unknown - no CTD extrema")

  before <- extrema_df %>% filter(local_dt <= query_time) %>% slice_tail(n = 1)
  after  <- extrema_df %>% filter(local_dt  > query_time) %>% slice_head(n = 1)

  # Within ±STAGE_WINDOW_MIN of an extremum?
  if (nrow(before) > 0) {
    dt_b <- abs(as.numeric(difftime(query_time, before$local_dt, units = "mins")))
    if (dt_b <= STAGE_WINDOW_MIN)
      return(if (before$noaa_type == "H") "High" else "Low")
  }
  if (nrow(after) > 0) {
    dt_a <- abs(as.numeric(difftime(after$local_dt, query_time, units = "mins")))
    if (dt_a <= STAGE_WINDOW_MIN)
      return(if (after$noaa_type == "H") "High" else "Low")
  }

  # Between two extrema → infer direction
  if (nrow(before) > 0 & nrow(after) > 0) {
    return(case_when(
      before$noaa_type == "H" & after$noaa_type == "L" ~ "Falling (Ebb)",
      before$noaa_type == "L" & after$noaa_type == "H" ~ "Rising (Flood)",
      before$noaa_type == "H"                           ~ "Falling (Ebb)",
      TRUE                                              ~ "Rising (Flood)"
    ))
  }
  if (nrow(before) == 0)
    return(if (after$noaa_type == "H") "Rising (Flood)" else "Falling (Ebb)")
  return(if (before$noaa_type == "H") "Falling (Ebb)" else "Rising (Flood)")
}

# Majority-stage helper for switching windows
majority_stage <- function(win_start, win_end, extrema_df) {
  crossings <- extrema_df %>%
    filter(local_dt > win_start, local_dt < win_end) %>%
    arrange(local_dt)

  if (nrow(crossings) == 0)
    return(list(stage = NA_character_, note = NA_character_))

  crossing_dt   <- crossings$local_dt[1]
  crossing_type <- crossings$noaa_type[1]

  win_total_min <- as.numeric(difftime(win_end, win_start, units = "mins"))
  seg1_min      <- as.numeric(difftime(crossing_dt, win_start, units = "mins"))
  seg2_min      <- as.numeric(difftime(win_end, crossing_dt, units = "mins"))

  stage_before <- if (crossing_type == "H") "Rising (Flood)" else "Falling (Ebb)"
  stage_after  <- if (crossing_type == "H") "Falling (Ebb)"  else "Rising (Flood)"

  pct_before <- round(100 * seg1_min / win_total_min)
  pct_after  <- round(100 * seg2_min / win_total_min)

  list(
    stage = if (seg1_min >= seg2_min) stage_before else stage_after,
    note  = sprintf("%d%% %s / %d%% %s",
                    pct_before, stage_before,
                    pct_after, stage_after)
  )
}

tidal_stage_results <- sampling_events %>%
  mutate(
    stage_at_start = map_chr(start_dt,     ~ assign_tidal_stage(.x, local_extrema)),
    stage_at_mid   = map_chr(midpoint_dt,  ~ assign_tidal_stage(.x, local_extrema)),
    stage_at_end   = map_chr(assess_end_dt,~ assign_tidal_stage(.x, local_extrema)),

    Tide_Switching = (stage_at_start != stage_at_end),

    majority       = map2(start_dt, assess_end_dt,
                          ~ majority_stage(.x, .y, local_extrema)),
    majority_stage_val  = map_chr(majority, "stage"),
    Tide_Stage_Split    = map_chr(majority, "note"),

    Tide_Stage_Majority = case_when(
      !Tide_Switching            ~ stage_at_mid,
      !is.na(majority_stage_val) ~ majority_stage_val,
      TRUE                       ~ stage_at_mid
    ),
    Tide_Stage_Split = case_when(
      !Tide_Switching ~ paste0("100% ", Tide_Stage_Majority),
      TRUE            ~ Tide_Stage_Split
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Date, Date_parsed, Field_Time_Start, Field_Time_Finish,
    window_flag, duration_h,
    start_dt, assess_end_dt, midpoint_dt,
    stage_at_start, stage_at_mid, stage_at_end,
    Tide_Stage_Majority, Tide_Switching, Tide_Stage_Split
  )

message("\n=== TIDAL STAGE ASSIGNMENT RESULTS ===\n")
print(
  tidal_stage_results %>%
    select(Date, Field_Time_Start, Field_Time_Finish, window_flag,
           Tide_Stage_Majority, Tide_Switching, Tide_Stage_Split),
  n = 20
)
```

## 6. Merge tidal stage onto full sample dataset & save
```{r merge-and-save}
samples_with_stage <- samples_raw %>%
  mutate(Date_parsed = suppressWarnings(ymd(Date))) %>%
  left_join(
    tidal_stage_results %>%
      select(Date_parsed, Field_Time_Start, Tide_Stage_Majority, window_flag,
             Tide_Switching, Tide_Stage_Split, start_dt, assess_end_dt, midpoint_dt),
    by = c("Date_parsed", "Field_Time_Start")
  ) %>%
  select(-Date_parsed) %>%
  relocate(Tide_Stage_Majority, Tide_Switching, Tide_Stage_Split, window_flag,
           .after = Field_Time_Finish)
```

## 7. Moon phase, tidal regime, & height-difference calculations
```{r moon-phase-regime}
# 7a. Daily moon phase for every date in the CTD record -----------------------
ctd_dates <- tibble(
  date = seq(as.Date(min(ctd$datetime)),
             as.Date(max(ctd$datetime)),
             by = "day")
) %>%
  mutate(
    moon_phase_rad  = lunar.phase(date),
    moon_phase_deg  = moon_phase_rad * (180 / pi),
    moon_phase_frac = moon_phase_rad / (2 * pi),

    moon_phase_name = case_when(
      moon_phase_frac < 0.0625 | moon_phase_frac >= 0.9375 ~ "New Moon",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.1875  ~ "Waxing Crescent",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.3125  ~ "First Quarter",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.4375  ~ "Waxing Gibbous",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.5625  ~ "Full Moon",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.6875  ~ "Waning Gibbous",
      moon_phase_frac < 0.8125  ~ "Last Quarter",
      TRUE                      ~ "Waning Crescent"
    ),

    # Spring / Neap classification (±2 days of lunar synodic cycle)
    dist_to_new  = pmin(moon_phase_frac, 1 - moon_phase_frac),
    dist_to_full = abs(moon_phase_frac - 0.5),
    tidal_regime = case_when(
      pmin(dist_to_new, dist_to_full) < (2 / 29.53) ~ "Spring",
      abs(moon_phase_frac - 0.25)    < (2 / 29.53)  ~ "Neap",
      abs(moon_phase_frac - 0.75)    < (2 / 29.53)  ~ "Neap",
      TRUE                                           ~ "Intermediate"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-dist_to_new, -dist_to_full)

# 7b. Lunar perigee detection -------------------------------------------------
PERIGEE_THRESHOLD <- 0.98

ctd_dates <- ctd_dates %>%
  mutate(
    lunar_distance = lunar.distance(date),
    near_perigee   = lunar_distance < PERIGEE_THRESHOLD,
    is_king_tide   = near_perigee & tidal_regime == "Spring"
  )

king_tide_dates <- ctd_dates %>% filter(is_king_tide) %>% pull(date)
message(sprintf("King Tide dates in CTD period: %s",
                paste(format(king_tide_dates, "%b %d"), collapse = ", ")))

# 7c. Attach moon phase & regime to local_extrema ----------------------------
local_extrema <- local_extrema %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(local_dt)) %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>%
              select(date, moon_phase_frac, moon_phase_name,
                     tidal_regime, lunar_distance, near_perigee, is_king_tide),
            by = "date") %>%
  select(-date)

# 7d. Attach moon phase to tidal_stage_results & samples_with_stage ----------
tidal_stage_results <- tidal_stage_results %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>%
              select(date, moon_phase_frac, moon_phase_name,
                     tidal_regime, lunar_distance, near_perigee, is_king_tide),
            by = c("Date_parsed" = "date"))

samples_with_stage <- samples_with_stage %>%
  mutate(Date_parsed = suppressWarnings(ymd(Date))) %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>%
              select(date, moon_phase_frac, moon_phase_name,
                     tidal_regime, lunar_distance, near_perigee, is_king_tide),
            by = c("Date_parsed" = "date")) %>%
  select(-Date_parsed)
```

## 8. Storm Wali disruption analysis

This section quantifies how Storm Wali (July 20–23, 2014) disrupted tidal
dynamics at HFP.  We compare mean high-water and mean low-water levels
before, during, and after the storm, and classify tidal extrema into
major and minor constituents to separate the physical fishpond response
from mixed semi-diurnal aliasing.

```{r major-minor-classification}
# ---------- 8a. Build full-CTD-period local extrema ---------------------------
noaa_full_period <- tides_noaa %>%
  filter(as.Date(datetime) >= as.Date(min(ctd$datetime)) - 1,
         as.Date(datetime) <= as.Date(max(ctd$datetime)) + 1)

local_extrema_full <- noaa_full_period %>%
  rename(noaa_dt          = datetime,
         noaa_verified_m = verified_m,
         noaa_pred_hl_m  = pred_m,
         noaa_type        = tide_type) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    extr     = list(find_local_extremum(noaa_dt, noaa_type, ctd, noaa_obs)),
    local_dt = extr[["local_dt"]],
    local_p  = extr[["local_p"]],
    lag_min  = extr[["lag_min"]]
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-extr) %>%
  filter(!is.na(local_dt)) %>%
  arrange(local_dt)

# ---------- 8b. Classify major vs minor tidal constituents --------------------
# Hawai"i has a mixed semi-diurnal tide (two unequal high/low pairs per day).
# Mākāhā act as a low-pass filter, attenuating the minor oscillation; minor
# NOAA events often match to noise peaks (lag < 10 min) rather than true
# fishpond responses.
# Classification: for each consecutive same-type pair (H1 ... L ... H2), the
# extremum with larger NOAA height (H) or smaller height (L) = Major; the
# other = Minor.

classify_major_minor <- function(ext_df) {
  ext_df <- ext_df %>% arrange(noaa_dt)
  n <- nrow(ext_df)
  ext_df$constituent <- NA_character_

  for (i in seq_len(n - 2)) {
    j <- i + 2
    if (j > n) next
    if (ext_df$noaa_type[i] != ext_df$noaa_type[j]) next

    if (ext_df$noaa_type[i] == "H") {
      if (ext_df$noaa_verified_m[i] >= ext_df$noaa_verified_m[j]) {
        ext_df$constituent[i] <- "Major"
        if (is.na(ext_df$constituent[j])) ext_df$constituent[j] <- "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$constituent[i] <- "Minor"
        if (is.na(ext_df$constituent[j])) ext_df$constituent[j] <- "Major"
      }
    } else {
      if (ext_df$noaa_verified_m[i] <= ext_df$noaa_verified_m[j]) {
        ext_df$constituent[i] <- "Major"
        if (is.na(ext_df$constituent[j])) ext_df$constituent[j] <- "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$constituent[i] <- "Minor"
        if (is.na(ext_df$constituent[j])) ext_df$constituent[j] <- "Major"
      }
    }
  }

  # Fill remaining NAs at edges using median of known values per type
  for (tt in c("H", "L")) {
    idx_na    <- which(ext_df$noaa_type == tt & is.na(ext_df$constituent))
    idx_known <- which(ext_df$noaa_type == tt & !is.na(ext_df$constituent))
    if (length(idx_known) == 0 | length(idx_na) == 0) next
    med_val <- median(ext_df$noaa_verified_m[idx_known])
    for (k in idx_na) {
      if (tt == "H") {
        ext_df$constituent[k] <- if (ext_df$noaa_verified_m[k] >= med_val) "Major" else "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$constituent[k] <- if (ext_df$noaa_verified_m[k] <= med_val) "Major" else "Minor"
      }
    }
  }
  ext_df
}

local_extrema_full <- classify_major_minor(local_extrema_full)

message("\n=== MAJOR / MINOR CLASSIFICATION ===")
print(local_extrema_full %>% count(noaa_type, constituent))

# ---------- 8b-ii. CTD prominence filter --------------------------------------
# Even for Major NOAA events, the CTD search sometimes matches a noise peak
# near t=0 rather than the true fishpond response (producing spuriously small
# lags). Prominence = how much the matched CTD extremum stands out from
# surrounding values; flags real responses from noise.
#
#   For a CTD High: prominence = local_p - min(CTD within ±PROM_WINDOW_MIN)
#   For a CTD Low:  prominence = max(CTD within ±PROM_WINDOW_MIN) - local_p
#
# Matches with prominence below PROM_THRESHOLD_DBAR flagged as low-confidence.

PROM_WINDOW_MIN    <- 90L     # minutes either side for prominence calc
PROM_THRESHOLD_DBAR <- 0.03   # minimum prominence to be "high confidence"

compute_prominence <- function(ext_df, ctd_data,
                                prom_window = PROM_WINDOW_MIN,
                                prom_thresh = PROM_THRESHOLD_DBAR) {
  pw <- dminutes(prom_window)
  
  ext_df %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      # Get CTD values within ±prom_window of the matched time
      prom_val = {
        win <- ctd_data %>%
          filter(datetime >= local_dt - pw,
                 datetime <= local_dt + pw)
        if (nrow(win) < 3) {
          NA_real_
        } else if (noaa_type == "H") {
          local_p - min(win$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
        } else {
          max(win$pressure, na.rm = TRUE) - local_p
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      confidence = case_when(
        is.na(prom_val)            ~ "Unknown",
        prom_val >= prom_thresh    ~ "High",
        TRUE                       ~ "Low"
      )
    )
}

message("Computing CTD prominence for each matched extremum...")
local_extrema_full <- compute_prominence(local_extrema_full, ctd)

message("\n=== PROMINENCE SUMMARY ===")
print(
  local_extrema_full %>%
    group_by(noaa_type, constituent, confidence) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              mean_prom = round(mean(prom_val, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
              mean_lag  = round(mean(lag_min, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(noaa_type, constituent, confidence)
)

# High-confidence major events = true fishpond tidal responses
n_hc_major <- local_extrema_full %>%
  filter(constituent == "Major", confidence == "High") %>%
  nrow()
message(sprintf("\nHigh-confidence major extrema: %d (used for lag & storm analysis)", n_hc_major))

message("\nLag statistics by constituent + confidence:")
print(
  local_extrema_full %>%
    filter(!is.na(lag_min)) %>%
    group_by(noaa_type, constituent, confidence) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              mean_lag = round(mean(lag_min), 1),
              sd_lag   = round(sd(lag_min), 1),
              median_lag = round(median(lag_min), 1),
              .groups = "drop")
)
```

```{r independent-ctd-extrema}
# ---------- 8c. Detect CTD tidal extrema INDEPENDENTLY ------------------------
# Previous approach searched CTD within a window around each NOAA event,
# biasing toward CTD peaks coincident with NOAA times.
#
# Current approach: detect CTD peaks/troughs via rolling-window method (same
# algorithm as NOAA verified signal in Section 2b), classify as major/minor
# within CTD itself, then match NOAA major events to CTD major events by
# nearest-subsequent same-type pairing.
#
# Eliminates the search-window bias since CTD peaks are found purely from
# the CTD pressure shape.

CTD_EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN <- 180L  # min either side; must separate
                                      # consecutive same-type extrema
                                      # (~6 h apart in semi-diurnal regime)

detect_ctd_extrema <- function(ctd_df, half_window_min = CTD_EXTREMA_HALF_WINDOW_MIN) {
  hw <- dminutes(half_window_min)

  candidates <- ctd_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_high = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- ctd_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        pressure[i] == max(win$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
      }),
      is_low = map_lgl(seq_len(n()), function(i) {
        win <- ctd_df %>%
          filter(datetime >= datetime[i] - hw,
                 datetime <= datetime[i] + hw)
        pressure[i] == min(win$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
      })
    ) %>%
    filter(is_high | is_low) %>%
    mutate(ctd_type = case_when(
      is_high & !is_low ~ "H",
      is_low & !is_high ~ "L",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>%
    filter(!is.na(ctd_type))

  # Collapse runs of same type to single peak
  candidates %>%
    arrange(datetime) %>%
    mutate(type_run = cumsum(ctd_type != lag(ctd_type, default = ""))) %>%
    group_by(type_run) %>%
    slice(
      if (first(ctd_type) == "H") which.max(pressure)
      else which.min(pressure)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(datetime, pressure, ctd_type) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
}

message("Detecting CTD tidal extrema independently (this may take 1-2 min)...")
ctd_extrema_ind <- detect_ctd_extrema(ctd)
message(sprintf("Detected %d independent CTD extrema", nrow(ctd_extrema_ind)))
print(head(ctd_extrema_ind, 10))

# ---------- 8d. Classify CTD extrema as major/minor --------------------------
# Same logic as NOAA classification: consecutive same-type pair,
# the one with higher pressure (for H) or lower (for L) is Major.

classify_ctd_major_minor <- function(ext_df) {
  ext_df <- ext_df %>% arrange(datetime)
  n <- nrow(ext_df)
  ext_df$ctd_constituent <- NA_character_

  for (i in seq_len(n - 2)) {
    j <- i + 2
    if (j > n) next
    if (ext_df$ctd_type[i] != ext_df$ctd_type[j]) next

    if (ext_df$ctd_type[i] == "H") {
      if (ext_df$pressure[i] >= ext_df$pressure[j]) {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[i] <- "Major"
        if (is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent[j])) ext_df$ctd_constituent[j] <- "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[i] <- "Minor"
        if (is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent[j])) ext_df$ctd_constituent[j] <- "Major"
      }
    } else {
      if (ext_df$pressure[i] <= ext_df$pressure[j]) {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[i] <- "Major"
        if (is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent[j])) ext_df$ctd_constituent[j] <- "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[i] <- "Minor"
        if (is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent[j])) ext_df$ctd_constituent[j] <- "Major"
      }
    }
  }

  # Fill edge NAs by median comparison
  for (tt in c("H", "L")) {
    idx_na    <- which(ext_df$ctd_type == tt & is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent))
    idx_known <- which(ext_df$ctd_type == tt & !is.na(ext_df$ctd_constituent))
    if (length(idx_known) == 0 | length(idx_na) == 0) next
    med_val <- median(ext_df$pressure[idx_known])
    for (k in idx_na) {
      if (tt == "H") {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[k] <- if (ext_df$pressure[k] >= med_val) "Major" else "Minor"
      } else {
        ext_df$ctd_constituent[k] <- if (ext_df$pressure[k] <= med_val) "Major" else "Minor"
      }
    }
  }
  ext_df
}

ctd_extrema_ind <- classify_ctd_major_minor(ctd_extrema_ind)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT CTD EXTREMA: MAJOR / MINOR ===")
print(ctd_extrema_ind %>% count(ctd_type, ctd_constituent))

# ---------- 8e. Match NOAA major -> CTD major (independent lag) ---------------
# For each independently-detected CTD peak, find the most recent preceding
# NOAA H/L of the same type. Measures the actual propagation delay without
# requiring alignment of NOAA vs CTD major/minor classifications; the
# fishpond"s strong low-pass filtering means CTD peak timing doesn"t
# correspond to NOAA major classification.

MATCH_MAX_LAG_MIN <- 180L  # max lag (4 hours)

# All NOAA detected H/L events (not just "major")
noaa_all_hl <- noaa_full_period %>%
  rename(noaa_dt          = datetime,
         noaa_verified_m = verified_m,
         noaa_type        = tide_type) %>%
  select(noaa_dt, noaa_type, noaa_verified_m) %>%
  arrange(noaa_dt)

# All independently-detected CTD peaks
ctd_all_peaks <- ctd_extrema_ind %>%
  rename(ctd_dt = datetime, ctd_p = pressure)

match_results <- vector("list", nrow(ctd_all_peaks))

for (i in seq_len(nrow(ctd_all_peaks))) {
  c_dt   <- ctd_all_peaks$ctd_dt[i]
  c_type <- ctd_all_peaks$ctd_type[i]
  c_p    <- ctd_all_peaks$ctd_p[i]

  # Find the most recent NOAA event of the same type preceding this CTD peak
  candidates <- noaa_all_hl %>%
    filter(noaa_type == c_type,
           noaa_dt < c_dt,
           noaa_dt >= c_dt - dminutes(MATCH_MAX_LAG_MIN))

  if (nrow(candidates) == 0) {
    match_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      ctd_dt = c_dt, ctd_type = c_type, ctd_p = c_p,
      ctd_constituent = ctd_all_peaks$ctd_constituent[i],
      noaa_dt = NA_POSIXct_, noaa_type = NA_character_,
      noaa_verified_m = NA_real_, ind_lag_min = NA_real_
    )
  } else {
    best <- candidates %>% slice_max(noaa_dt, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
    match_results[[i]] <- tibble(
      ctd_dt = c_dt, ctd_type = c_type, ctd_p = c_p,
      ctd_constituent = ctd_all_peaks$ctd_constituent[i],
      noaa_dt          = best$noaa_dt,
      noaa_type        = best$noaa_type,
      noaa_verified_m = best$noaa_verified_m,
      ind_lag_min      = as.numeric(difftime(c_dt, best$noaa_dt, units = "mins"))
    )
  }
}

independent_lag <- bind_rows(match_results) %>%
  filter(!is.na(ind_lag_min))

# Attach tidal regime and period
independent_lag <- independent_lag %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(noaa_dt)) %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>%
              select(date, tidal_regime, moon_phase_name),
            by = "date") %>%
  select(-date)

message(sprintf("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG: %d matched pairs ===", nrow(independent_lag)))
print(
  independent_lag %>%
    group_by(noaa_type) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              mean_lag = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
              sd_lag   = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
              median_lag = round(median(ind_lag_min), 1),
              min_lag = round(min(ind_lag_min), 1),
              max_lag = round(max(ind_lag_min), 1),
              .groups = "drop")
)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG BY REGIME ===")
print(
  independent_lag %>%
    filter(tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
    group_by(noaa_type, tidal_regime) %>%
    summarise(n = n(),
              mean_lag = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
              sd_lag   = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
              median_lag = round(median(ind_lag_min), 1),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(noaa_type, tidal_regime)
)
```

```{r storm-wali-disruption}
# ---------- 8f. Define analysis periods ---------------------------------------
PRE_STORM_DAYS  <- 14L
POST_STORM_DAYS <- 14L

pre_storm_start <- STORM_START - days(PRE_STORM_DAYS)

ctd_periods <- ctd %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      datetime >= pre_storm_start & datetime < STORM_START  ~ "Pre-storm",
      datetime >= STORM_START     & datetime < STORM_END    ~ "Storm",
      datetime >= STORM_END       & datetime < STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS) ~ "Post-storm",
      TRUE ~ "Outside"
    )
  )

# ---------- 8g. Mean high-water / low-water from INDEPENDENT CTD extrema ------
# Uses independently detected CTD major extrema (not NOAA-guided matches)
# for the storm disruption analysis. Avoids all search-window artifacts.

ctd_major_with_period <- ctd_extrema_ind %>%
  filter(ctd_constituent == "Major") %>%
  mutate(
    period = case_when(
      datetime >= pre_storm_start & datetime < STORM_START  ~ "Pre-storm",
      datetime >= STORM_START     & datetime < STORM_END    ~ "Storm",
      datetime >= STORM_END       & datetime < STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS) ~ "Post-storm",
      TRUE ~ "Outside"
    )
  )

hw_lw_summary <- ctd_major_with_period %>%
  filter(period != "Outside") %>%
  group_by(period, ctd_type) %>%
  summarise(n         = n(),
            mean_wl   = round(mean(pressure,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            sd_wl     = round(sd(pressure,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            median_wl = round(median(pressure, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            min_wl    = round(min(pressure,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            max_wl    = round(max(pressure,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(noaa_type = ctd_type) %>%   # keep column name consistent for plotting
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(period, noaa_type)

message("\n=== MEAN HIGH/LOW WATER BY PERIOD - INDEPENDENT CTD MAJOR (dbar) ===")
print(hw_lw_summary)

excursion_summary <- hw_lw_summary %>%
  select(period, noaa_type, mean_wl) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = noaa_type, values_from = mean_wl, names_prefix = "mean_") %>%
  mutate(tidal_excursion = round(mean_H - mean_L, 4))

# Per-cycle excursion: pair consecutive H/L extrema in ctd_major_with_period,
# compute amplitude per pair, then summarise mean ± SD by period.
excursion_per_cycle <- ctd_major_with_period %>%
  filter(period != "Outside") %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  mutate(next_type     = lead(ctd_type),
         next_pressure = lead(pressure)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_type), ctd_type != next_type) %>%
  mutate(amplitude = abs(pressure - next_pressure)) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cycles         = n(),
    excursion_mean   = round(mean(amplitude,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    excursion_sd     = round(sd(amplitude,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    excursion_median = round(median(amplitude, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    excursion_min    = round(min(amplitude,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    excursion_max    = round(max(amplitude,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(period)

# Merge per-cycle SD back into excursion_summary for symmetric reporting.
excursion_summary <- excursion_summary %>%
  left_join(excursion_per_cycle, by = "period")

message("\n=== TIDAL EXCURSION BY PERIOD (dbar) ===")
print(excursion_summary)

pre_excursion   <- excursion_summary$tidal_excursion[excursion_summary$period == "Pre-storm"]
storm_excursion <- excursion_summary$tidal_excursion[excursion_summary$period == "Storm"]
post_excursion  <- excursion_summary$tidal_excursion[excursion_summary$period == "Post-storm"]

pct_excursion_reduction_storm <- round(100 * (1 - storm_excursion / pre_excursion), 1)
pct_excursion_change_post     <- round(100 * (post_excursion / pre_excursion - 1), 1)

message(sprintf("\nStorm reduced major-tide excursion by %.1f%%", pct_excursion_reduction_storm))

# ---------- 8h. Individual HW/LW shifts --------------------------------------
pre_hw   <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Pre-storm", noaa_type == "H") %>% pull(mean_wl)
pre_lw   <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Pre-storm", noaa_type == "L") %>% pull(mean_wl)
storm_hw <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Storm",     noaa_type == "H") %>% pull(mean_wl)
storm_lw <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Storm",     noaa_type == "L") %>% pull(mean_wl)
post_hw  <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Post-storm", noaa_type == "H") %>% pull(mean_wl)
post_lw  <- hw_lw_summary %>% filter(period == "Post-storm", noaa_type == "L") %>% pull(mean_wl)

message(sprintf("High-water shift during storm: %+.4f dbar", storm_hw - pre_hw))
message(sprintf("Low-water shift during storm:  %+.4f dbar", storm_lw - pre_lw))

# ---------- 8i. Continuous mean water level -----------------------------------
mean_wl_by_period <- ctd_periods %>%
  filter(period != "Outside") %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(n_obs              = n(),
            mean_pressure_dbar   = round(mean(pressure,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            sd_pressure_dbar     = round(sd(pressure,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            median_pressure_dbar = round(median(pressure, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            min_pressure_dbar    = round(min(pressure,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            max_pressure_dbar    = round(max(pressure,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(period)

message("\n=== CONTINUOUS MEAN WATER LEVEL BY PERIOD (dbar) ===")
print(mean_wl_by_period)

# ---------- 8j. Neap/storm confound -------------------------------------------
ctd_major_with_period <- ctd_major_with_period %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(datetime)) %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>% select(date, tidal_regime), by = "date") %>%
  select(-date)

message("\n=== TIDAL REGIME DURING STORM PERIOD ===")
print(ctd_major_with_period %>%
        filter(period == "Storm") %>%
        count(tidal_regime) %>%
        mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 0)))

# ---------- 8k. Half-cycle tidal range (retained for reference) ---------------
tidal_ranges <- local_extrema_full %>%
  mutate(next_p = lead(local_p), next_type = lead(noaa_type),
         next_dt = lead(local_dt),
         tidal_range_dbar = abs(local_p - next_p),
         midpoint = local_dt + (next_dt - local_dt) / 2) %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_p), noaa_type != next_type) %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    midpoint >= pre_storm_start & midpoint < STORM_START  ~ "Pre-storm",
    midpoint >= STORM_START     & midpoint < STORM_END    ~ "Storm",
    midpoint >= STORM_END       & midpoint < STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS) ~ "Post-storm",
    TRUE ~ "Outside"))
```

---

## 9. Lag analysis: NOAA Moku o Lo"e -> HFP by tide type & tidal regime

Lag is computed using the **independent-matching** method: CTD tidal peaks
and troughs are detected from the pressure signal alone (Section 8c–d),
then each NOAA major extremum is matched to the nearest subsequent CTD
major extremum of the same type. This avoids the search-window bias of the
original NOAA-guided approach.

```{r lag-analysis}
# The independent_lag dataframe was built in Section 8e: all CTD-detected
# extrema (major + minor constituents) matched to the most recent preceding
# NOAA H/L event of the same type. All matched pairs retained without further
# constituent filtering — mākāhā attenuate the minor constituent so heavily
# that the CTD signal is dominated by major-cycle responses, and a CTD-only
# major filter interacts poorly with the matching algorithm (which does not
# restrict the NOAA side to majors).
lag_data <- independent_lag

# ---------- 9a. Overall lag ---------------------------------------------------
lag_overall <- lag_data %>%
  group_by(noaa_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_lag   = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
            sd_lag     = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
            median_lag = round(median(ind_lag_min), 1),
            min_lag    = round(min(ind_lag_min), 1),
            max_lag    = round(max(ind_lag_min), 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(tide_type = noaa_type)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG OVERALL (NOAA major -> CTD major, minutes) ===")
print(lag_overall)

# ---------- 9b. Lag by tide type x tidal regime --------------------------------
lag_by_regime <- lag_data %>%
  group_by(noaa_type, tidal_regime) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_lag   = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
            sd_lag     = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
            median_lag = round(median(ind_lag_min), 1),
            min_lag    = round(min(ind_lag_min), 1),
            max_lag    = round(max(ind_lag_min), 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(tide_type = noaa_type) %>%
  arrange(tide_type, tidal_regime)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG BY REGIME (minutes) ===")
print(lag_by_regime)

# ---------- 9c. Lag by all regimes (unfiltered diagnostic) -------------------
lag_by_regime_all <- lag_data %>%
  group_by(noaa_type, tidal_regime) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_lag   = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
            sd_lag     = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
            median_lag = round(median(ind_lag_min), 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  rename(tide_type = noaa_type) %>%
  arrange(tide_type, tidal_regime)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG BY REGIME (all regimes) ===")
print(lag_by_regime_all)

# ---------- 9d. Storm-period lag ----------------------------------------------
lag_data_storm <- lag_data %>%
  mutate(storm_period = case_when(
    noaa_dt >= pre_storm_start & noaa_dt < STORM_START  ~ "Pre-storm",
    noaa_dt >= STORM_START     & noaa_dt < STORM_END    ~ "Storm",
    noaa_dt >= STORM_END       & noaa_dt < STORM_END + days(7) ~ "Post-storm (1 wk)",
    TRUE ~ "Other")) %>%
  filter(storm_period != "Other")

lag_storm_summary <- lag_data_storm %>%
  group_by(storm_period, noaa_type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_lag = round(mean(ind_lag_min), 1),
            sd_lag   = round(sd(ind_lag_min), 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(storm_period = factor(storm_period,
                               levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm (1 wk)"))) %>%
  arrange(storm_period, noaa_type) %>%
  rename(tide_type = noaa_type)

message("\n=== INDEPENDENT LAG BY STORM PERIOD (minutes) ===")
print(lag_storm_summary)
```

## 12. Exploratory gap analyses

Six aspects of fishpond tidal dynamics not yet covered in Sections 8–11. Each
subsection produces diagnostic plots and summary tables; promote any to Figure
S1 / Table S3 if results merit. Computed here so that all subsequent sections
can optionally use these objects, and so a single knit produces every output.

```{r gap-setup}
# ── He"eia Fishpond geometry (Tognacchini 2015) ──
# Surface area: ~88 acres = 356,131 m² (Methods)
FISHPOND_AREA_M2 <- 356123
DBAR_TO_M        <- 1.00     # at fishpond salinities (~10–26 PSU)

# ── Mean tidal-cycle water column depth ──
# Derived from Tognacchini (2015) bathymetric measurements:
#   - Mean fishpond depth at neap low water: 0.38 m (spatial average)
#   - Average tidal range: 0.72 m
# Tidal-cycle mean depth = neap LW depth + half tidal range
#                        = 0.38 + (0.72/2) = 0.74 m
# Preferred over CTD pressure mean (~0.46 m), which only reflects water
# column above the sensor at one location and underestimates whole-pond
# mean depth. Tognacchini value is a spatial average across the fishpond
# at a documented tidal phase.
NEAP_LW_DEPTH_M    <- 0.38
AVG_TIDAL_RANGE_M  <- 0.72
mean_depth_m       <- NEAP_LW_DEPTH_M + (AVG_TIDAL_RANGE_M / 2)  # = 0.74 m
mean_volume_m3     <- mean_depth_m * FISHPOND_AREA_M2

# For comparison: CTD-pressure-mean depth (not used for V_mean)
mean_pressure_dbar <- mean(ctd$pressure, na.rm = TRUE)
ctd_depth_m        <- mean_pressure_dbar * DBAR_TO_M

message(sprintf("Mean tidal-cycle depth (Tognacchini-derived): %.2f m", mean_depth_m))
message(sprintf("CTD pressure mean (for comparison only):       %.2f m", ctd_depth_m))
message(sprintf("Mean fishpond volume: %.0f m³ (%.2f million m³)",
                mean_volume_m3, mean_volume_m3 / 1e6))
```

### 12.1 Half-cycle data (shared by Sections 12.1–12.4)

Pair consecutive extrema from `local_extrema_full`, attach `tidal_regime` and
`moon_phase_name` from `ctd_dates` by date.

```{r gap-half-cycle}
# Pairs consecutive extrema from local_extrema_full to build half-cycles. No
# constituent-classification filter applied: requiring both endpoints to be
# Major produces an unrepresentative subset (cases where the intervening
# minor extremum was missed by detection). All detected half-cycles accepted;
# duration (3–18 h) and amplitude (>0.05 m excursion) filters drop physically
# implausible or noise-dominated pairs. Mākāhā"s strong filtering of the
# minor constituent ensures the major-cycle signal dominates regardless.

half_cycle <- local_extrema_full %>%
  arrange(local_dt) %>%
  mutate(
    next_p   = lead(local_p),
    next_t   = lead(local_dt),
    next_typ = lead(noaa_type),
    half_cycle_hr  = as.numeric(difftime(next_t, local_dt, units = "hours")),
    excursion_m    = abs(next_p - local_p) * DBAR_TO_M,
    tidal_prism_m3 = excursion_m * FISHPOND_AREA_M2,
    direction      = case_when(
      noaa_type == "L" & next_typ == "H" ~ "Rising",
      noaa_type == "H" & next_typ == "L" ~ "Falling",
      TRUE                               ~ NA_character_
    ),
    residence_hr = (mean_volume_m3 / tidal_prism_m3) * half_cycle_hr,
    residence_d  = residence_hr / 24,
    # Use the half-cycle midpoint to assign storm period
    midpoint_dt  = local_dt + (next_t - local_dt) / 2,
    period       = case_when(
      midpoint_dt >= pre_storm_start & midpoint_dt < STORM_START ~ "Pre-storm",
      midpoint_dt >= STORM_START     & midpoint_dt < STORM_END   ~ "Storm",
      midpoint_dt >= STORM_END       & midpoint_dt <  STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS) ~ "Post-storm",
      TRUE                                                       ~ "Outside"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(direction),
         half_cycle_hr > 3, half_cycle_hr < 18,
         excursion_m   > 0.05) %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(local_dt)) %>%
  left_join(ctd_dates %>% select(date, tidal_regime, moon_phase_name),
            by = "date") %>%
  select(-date)

message(sprintf("Half-cycles built: %d (after filtering)", nrow(half_cycle)))
message("Half-cycles by period:")
print(half_cycle %>% count(period))
```

### 12.2 Residence time / flushing time

Tidal-prism approximation: τ = (V_mean / P_halfcycle) × T_halfcycle, where
V_mean is mean fishpond volume, P is tidal prism per half-cycle, T is the
half-cycle period. This is a **lower-bound** estimate that assumes complete
mixing and complete prism exchange each cycle. Real residence times in
restricted basins are typically 2–5× longer due to incomplete mixing
("return-flow factor" or "exchange ratio" ≈ 0.2–0.5). For Heʻeia
specifically, Tognacchini (2015, citing Timmermann et al., in prep.) reports
an empirical average HFP recovery time of ~4 days, implying an effective
exchange ratio near 0.2 in this restricted system.

Volume here uses the mean CTD pressure (~0.46 m water column above sensor)
as a proxy for mean fishpond depth. This is a documented approximation;
sensor placement adds ~0.06 m uncertainty.

```{r gap-residence-time}
# ── Pre-storm baseline by regime (matches Figure S1 panel context) ──
res_summary <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  group_by(tidal_regime) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean_excursion = round(mean(excursion_m, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    mean_prism_m3  = round(mean(tidal_prism_m3, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    mean_res_d     = round(mean(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_res_d   = round(median(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_res_d       = round(sd(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_res_d      = round(min(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_res_d      = round(max(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
message("\n=== RESIDENCE TIME BY REGIME (all periods combined) ===")
print(res_summary)

# ── By regime × period (informative for storm/post-storm comparison) ──
res_by_period <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap"),
         period %in% c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm")) %>%
  group_by(period, tidal_regime) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    mean_res_d   = round(mean(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_res_d = round(median(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    sd_res_d     = round(sd(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    min_res_d    = round(min(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    max_res_d    = round(max(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(period, tidal_regime)
message("\n=== RESIDENCE TIME BY PERIOD × REGIME ===")
print(res_by_period)

# ── By period only (n in storm is small; useful as a sense check) ──
res_by_period_only <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(period %in% c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm")) %>%
  group_by(period) %>%
  summarise(
    n            = n(),
    mean_res_d   = round(mean(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    median_res_d = round(median(residence_d, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(period = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(period)
message("\n=== RESIDENCE TIME BY PERIOD (overall) ===")
print(res_by_period_only)

# ── Diagnostic boxplot: residence time by regime (regime-only) ──
# Exploratory view; the publication-quality Figure S1 Panel F equivalent
# is built in build-residence-boxplot below (object p_residence).
p_residence_diag <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  mutate(tidal_regime = factor(tidal_regime,
                               levels = c("Spring", "Neap"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tidal_regime, residence_d, fill = tidal_regime)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.4, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues", guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Residence time by tidal regime (diagnostic)",
       subtitle = "Tidal-prism estimate; lower bound (complete-mixing assumption)",
       x = "Tidal regime", y = "Residence time (days)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_residence_diag)

# ── Time-series: residence per cycle through record, with storm shading ──
# Shows storm/post-storm dynamics that the boxplot collapses across.
p_residence_ts <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap"),
         midpoint_dt >= pre_storm_start,
         midpoint_dt <  STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS)) %>%
  mutate(tidal_regime = factor(tidal_regime,
                               levels = c("Spring", "Neap"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(midpoint_dt, residence_d)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = as_datetime(STORM_START), xmax = as_datetime(STORM_END),
           ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, fill = "#dfdfdf", alpha = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = as_datetime(STORM_START) + hours(36), y = Inf,
           label = "Storm Wali", vjust = 1.3, size = 3,
           color = "black", fontface = "italic") +
  geom_point(aes(color = tidal_regime), size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60", alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Spring" = "#1F4E79",
                                "Neap" = "#C6DBEF")) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%b %d", date_breaks = "3 days",
                   limits = c(as_datetime(pre_storm_start),
                              as_datetime(STORM_END + days(POST_STORM_DAYS))),
                   expand = expansion(mult = 0.01)) +
  labs(title = "Residence time per half-cycle through the record",
       subtitle = "Storm period shaded; colored by tidal regime",
       x = NULL, y = "Residence time (days)", color = "Regime") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_residence_ts)
```

### 12.3 Tidal prism per regime

Volume of water exchanged per half-cycle. **Caveat on direction asymmetry:**
the flooding vs. ebbing counts are unbalanced (more ebbs than floods detected
in some regimes), likely because the `excursion_m > 0.05` filter drops more
short half-cycles in one direction than the other. This makes the
flood-vs-ebb *prism* comparison unreliable. The flux-rate asymmetry (Section
12.4) covers the same physics on firmer methodological ground. Total prism
by regime (regardless of direction) is the more interpretable quantity here.

```{r gap-tidal-prism}
prism_summary <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  group_by(tidal_regime, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    mean_prism_m3  = round(mean(tidal_prism_m3, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    sd_prism_m3    = round(sd(tidal_prism_m3, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
message("\n=== TIDAL PRISM BY REGIME × DIRECTION ===")
print(prism_summary)

p_prism <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  mutate(tidal_regime = factor(tidal_regime,
                               levels = c("Spring", "Neap"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(tidal_regime, tidal_prism_m3 / 1000, fill = direction)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Rising" = "#5B9BD5", "Falling" = "#ED7D31")) +
  labs(title = "Tidal prism by regime and flow direction",
       x = "Tidal regime",
       y = expression("Tidal prism (×10"^3*" m"^3*")"),
       fill = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
print(p_prism)
```

### 12.4 Asymmetric flux (rise rate vs. fall rate)

Mean pressure change rate per half-cycle, comparing flooding to ebbing within
each regime. Flood/ebb ratio > 1 means filling faster than draining.

```{r gap-asymmetric-flux}
flux_data <- half_cycle %>%
  mutate(
    flux_rate_dbar_per_hr = (next_p - local_p) / half_cycle_hr,
    abs_flux_dbar_per_hr  = abs(flux_rate_dbar_per_hr)
  )

flux_summary <- flux_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  group_by(tidal_regime, direction) %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    mean_rate   = round(mean(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sd_rate     = round(sd(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_rate = round(median(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    min_rate    = round(min(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    max_rate    = round(max(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr,    na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(tidal_regime, direction)
message("\n=== ASYMMETRIC FLUX BY REGIME × DIRECTION ===")
print(flux_summary)

flood_ebb_test <- flux_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  group_by(tidal_regime) %>%
  summarise(
    n_rising    = sum(direction == "Rising"),
    n_falling   = sum(direction == "Falling"),
    rising_mean   = round(mean(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Rising"],
                               na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    falling_mean  = round(mean(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Falling"],
                               na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    rising_median  = round(median(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Rising"],
                                  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    falling_median = round(median(abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Falling"],
                                  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    asymmetry_ratio = round(rising_mean / falling_mean, 2),
    # Wilcoxon rank-sum test: extract W statistic and p-value together
    W_statistic = tryCatch(
      unname(wilcox.test(
        abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Rising"],
        abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Falling"]
      )$statistic),
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    p_value = tryCatch(
      wilcox.test(
        abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Rising"],
        abs_flux_dbar_per_hr[direction == "Falling"]
      )$p.value,
      error = function(e) NA_real_
    ),
    # Rank-biserial correlation effect size: r_rb = 2W/(n1·n2) - 1
    # Range [-1, +1]; positive = Rising tends larger than Falling
    effect_size_rrb = round(
      2 * W_statistic / (n_rising * n_falling) - 1, 3
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
message("\n=== FLOOD vs EBB ASYMMETRY TEST ===")
print(flood_ebb_test)

p_flux <- flux_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(tidal_regime),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap")) %>%
  mutate(tidal_regime = factor(tidal_regime,
                               levels = c("Spring", "Neap")),
         direction    = factor(direction,
                               levels = c("Rising", "Falling"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(direction, abs_flux_dbar_per_hr, fill = tidal_regime)) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = "errorbar", width = 0.3,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.5, outlier.size = 1.2,
               outlier.color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Spring" = "#3288BD",   # Spectral blue (stronger forcing)
                               "Neap"   = "#9ECAE1"),  # Lightened (weaker forcing)
                    name = "Tidal regime") +
  labs(x = "Flow direction",
       y = "Tidal flow rate\n(dbar hr⁻¹)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.margin = margin(t = 6, r = 6, b = 4, l = 6))
print(p_flux)
```

## 13. Supplementary Table S3: Tidal dynamics summary

```{r supp-table-s3}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Supplementary Table S3: Tidal dynamics at He"eia Fishpond
# Panel A: Tidal propagation lag by tide type and regime
# Panel B: Asymmetric tidal flux (flooding vs. ebbing) by regime
# Panel C: Storm Wali disruption of tidal dynamics
# Panel D: Tidal residence time estimates by regime (optional)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── Panel A: Tidal propagation lag by tide type and regime ──
# Rows grouped by Regime first (Spring, Neap, All), then by Tide within
# each regime. "All" row in the Regime column represents lag values pooled
# across regimes (Spring + Neap data combined) for each tide type.
panel_a_lag <- lag_by_regime %>%
  mutate(
    Tide = ifelse(tide_type == "H", "High (HHT + LHT)", "Low (LLT + HLT)"),
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_lag, " ± ", sd_lag),
    Range = paste0(min_lag, "–", max_lag)
  ) %>%
  select(tidal_regime, Tide, n, Mean_SD, median_lag, Range) %>%
  rename(Regime = tidal_regime, Median = median_lag)

panel_a_all <- lag_overall %>%
  mutate(
    Tide = ifelse(tide_type == "H", "High (HHT + LHT)", "Low (LLT + HLT)"),
    Regime = "All",
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_lag, " ± ", sd_lag),
    Range = paste0(min_lag, "–", max_lag)
  ) %>%
  select(Regime, Tide, n, Mean_SD, median_lag, Range) %>%
  rename(Median = median_lag)

panel_a <- bind_rows(panel_a_lag, panel_a_all) %>%
  mutate(
    Regime = factor(Regime, levels = c("Spring", "Neap", "All")),
    Tide   = factor(Tide,
                    levels = c("High (HHT + LHT)", "Low (LLT + HLT)"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Regime, Tide)

message("\n=== TABLE S3 PANEL A: TIDAL PROPAGATION LAG ===")
print(panel_a)

# ── Panel B: Asymmetric tidal flux by regime ──
# Combined display: per-direction stats (n, Mean ± SD, Median, Range) with
# regime-level Wilcoxon results (Rise:Fall Ratio, W, p, effect size r_rb)
# populated only on the Rising row of each regime to avoid duplication.
# ── Panel B: Asymmetric tidal flux by regime ──
# Rising vs falling pressure change rates per half-cycle. Uniform 6-column
# layout (Regime, Direction, n, Mean_SD, Median, Range) matching Panels A,
# C, D. Wilcoxon test results (W, p, effect size r_rb) computed separately
# in flood_ebb_test and reported in Section 13b.
panel_b <- flux_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Direction = direction,
    Mean_SD   = paste0(mean_rate, " ± ", sd_rate),
    Range     = paste0(min_rate, "–", max_rate)
  ) %>%
  select(tidal_regime, Direction, n, Mean_SD, median_rate, Range) %>%
  rename(Regime = tidal_regime, Median = median_rate) %>%
  mutate(Regime = factor(Regime, levels = c("Spring", "Neap"))) %>%
  arrange(Regime, Direction)

message("\n=== TABLE S3 PANEL B: ASYMMETRIC TIDAL FLUX (rising vs. falling) ===")
print(panel_b)

# ── Panel C: Storm Wali disruption of tidal dynamics ──
# Long format: rows are (Metric × Period); columns are n / Mean_SD / Median /
# Range. Metric ordering: continuous mean water level first (whole-record
# context), then discrete tidal extrema (HHT then LLT), then the derived
# tidal excursion. All values reported in dbar.

panel_c_mean_wl <- mean_wl_by_period %>%
  transmute(
    Metric  = "Total mean water level",
    Period  = period,
    n       = n_obs,
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_pressure_dbar, " ± ", sd_pressure_dbar),
    Median  = median_pressure_dbar,
    Range   = paste0(min_pressure_dbar, "–", max_pressure_dbar)
  )

panel_c_hht <- hw_lw_summary %>%
  filter(noaa_type == "H") %>%
  transmute(
    Metric  = "HHT water level",
    Period  = period,
    n       = n,
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_wl, " ± ", sd_wl),
    Median  = median_wl,
    Range   = paste0(min_wl, "–", max_wl)
  )

panel_c_llt <- hw_lw_summary %>%
  filter(noaa_type == "L") %>%
  transmute(
    Metric  = "LLT water level",
    Period  = period,
    n       = n,
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_wl, " ± ", sd_wl),
    Median  = median_wl,
    Range   = paste0(min_wl, "–", max_wl)
  )

panel_c_excursion <- excursion_per_cycle %>%
  transmute(
    Metric  = "Tidal excursion (HHT − LLT)",
    Period  = period,
    n       = n_cycles,
    Mean_SD = paste0(excursion_mean, " ± ", excursion_sd),
    Median  = excursion_median,
    Range   = paste0(excursion_min, "–", excursion_max)
  )

panel_c <- bind_rows(
  panel_c_mean_wl,
  panel_c_hht,
  panel_c_llt,
  panel_c_excursion
) %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c("Total mean water level",
                                       "HHT water level",
                                       "LLT water level",
                                       "Tidal excursion (HHT − LLT)")),
    Period = factor(Period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))
  ) %>%
  arrange(Metric, Period)

message("\n=== TABLE S3 PANEL C: STORM WALI DISRUPTION ===")
print(panel_c)

# ── Panel D: Residence time estimates by regime and storm period ──
# Geometric tidal-prism estimates from Section 12.2. Rows grouped first by
# Regime, then by Period: "All" (pooled across full deployment) followed by
# storm-window stratification (Pre-storm, Storm, Post-storm).
panel_d_regime <- res_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Regime   = factor(tidal_regime, levels = c("Spring", "Neap")),
    Period   = "All",
    Mean_SD  = paste0(mean_res_d, " ± ", sd_res_d),
    Range    = paste0(min_res_d, "–", max_res_d)
  ) %>%
  select(Regime, Period, n, Mean_SD, median_res_d, Range) %>%
  rename(Median = median_res_d)

panel_d_period_regime <- res_by_period %>%
  mutate(
    Regime  = factor(tidal_regime, levels = c("Spring", "Neap")),
    Period  = factor(period, levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm")),
    Mean_SD = paste0(mean_res_d, " ± ", sd_res_d),
    Range   = paste0(min_res_d, "–", max_res_d)
  ) %>%
  select(Regime, Period, n, Mean_SD, median_res_d, Range) %>%
  rename(Median = median_res_d)

# Merge "All" (Regime-only) and period-stratified rows, with Period ordering:
# All first, then Pre-storm → Storm → Post-storm. Group by Regime in output.
panel_d <- bind_rows(panel_d_regime, panel_d_period_regime) %>%
  mutate(Period = factor(Period,
                         levels = c("All", "Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"))) %>%
  arrange(Regime, Period)

message("\n=== TABLE S3 PANEL D: RESIDENCE TIME ESTIMATES (days) ===")
print(panel_d)

# ── Save all panels ──
# One CSV per sub-panel, content-descriptive filenames (decoupled from
# manuscript table numbering). write_excel_csv adds a UTF-8 BOM so Excel
# renders em-dashes, ±, and en-dashes correctly on both Mac and Windows.
# Statistical test results are computed and reported in Section 13b
# (Statistical tests); only descriptive summaries are written to CSV.

manuscript_output_path <- "/Users/becca/Documents/current projects/Manuscript Storm Wali/output/table_supp3_tidal_dynamics"

write_excel_csv(panel_a, file.path(manuscript_output_path, "tidal_lag_summary.csv"))
write_excel_csv(panel_b, file.path(manuscript_output_path, "tidal_flux_summary.csv"))
write_excel_csv(panel_c, file.path(manuscript_output_path, "storm_disruption_summary.csv"))
write_excel_csv(panel_d, file.path(manuscript_output_path, "residence_time_summary.csv"))

message("\nTable S3 panels saved to: ", manuscript_output_path)
```

## 13b. Statistical tests

Three tests answer the manuscript"s load-bearing statistical questions. Test
results print to the console only; descriptive summaries are in Table S3 and
test results are integrated into the supplementary text (Section 15).

Tests:
  1. Panel B Wilcoxon rank-sum (Spring): Rising vs Falling flow rates
  2. Panel B Wilcoxon rank-sum (Neap):  Rising vs Falling flow rates
  3. Panel D Gamma GLM + LRT: storm period effect on residence time,
     controlling for tidal regime

```{r statistical-tests}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Test 1 & 2: Wilcoxon rank-sum for Rising vs Falling flow rates
# Already computed in flood_ebb_test (Section 12.4); print results here.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

message("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")
message("STATISTICAL TESTS — Table S3 / Figure S1 supporting tests")
message("══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════")

message("\n── Tests 1 & 2: Rising vs Falling flow rate asymmetry (Wilcoxon) ──")
flood_ebb_test %>%
  transmute(
    Regime          = tidal_regime,
    n_Rising        = n_rising,
    n_Falling       = n_falling,
    Rising_mean     = rising_mean,
    Falling_mean    = falling_mean,
    Rise_Fall_Ratio = asymmetry_ratio,
    W_statistic     = W_statistic,
    p_value         = vapply(p_value,
                             function(p) if (is.na(p)) NA_character_
                                         else if (p < 0.0001) "<0.0001"
                                         else formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4),
                             character(1)),
    Effect_size_rrb = effect_size_rrb
  ) %>%
  print()
message("Interpretation: rank-biserial effect size r_rb in [-1, +1];")
message("  |r_rb| >= 0.5 = large effect, ~0.3 = medium, ~0.1 = small.")
message("  Positive r_rb means Rising rates exceed Falling rates.")

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Test 3: Storm period effect on residence time
# Gamma GLM with log link (appropriate for positive right-skewed time data).
# Pools Spring + Neap half-cycles; regime confound handled via the regime
# covariate in the full model.
#
# Nested model comparisons:
#   - Period effect, controlling for regime: m(regime) vs m(regime + period)
#   - Regime effect, controlling for period: m(period) vs m(regime + period)
#
# The Spring x Storm cell is empty (n = 0; the storm coincided with Neap),
# so the regime x period interaction model cannot be estimated and only
# the additive structure is tested.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

message("\n── Test 3: Storm period effect on residence time (Gamma GLM + LRT) ──")

lrt_data <- half_cycle %>%
  filter(period %in% c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm"),
         tidal_regime %in% c("Spring", "Neap"),
         !is.na(residence_d), residence_d > 0) %>%
  mutate(period       = factor(period,       levels = c("Pre-storm", "Storm", "Post-storm")),
         tidal_regime = factor(tidal_regime, levels = c("Spring", "Neap")))

# Nested Gamma GLMs
m_regime_only <- glm(residence_d ~ tidal_regime,
                     family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = lrt_data)
m_period_only <- glm(residence_d ~ period,
                     family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = lrt_data)
m_additive    <- glm(residence_d ~ tidal_regime + period,
                     family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = lrt_data)

# LRTs
lrt_period <- anova(m_regime_only, m_additive, test = "LRT")
lrt_regime <- anova(m_period_only, m_additive, test = "LRT")

# Multiplicative effects (back-transformed from log link) + 95% CIs
coef_table <- tibble(
  Term  = names(coef(m_additive)),
  log_estimate = coef(m_additive),
  log_lower = suppressMessages(confint(m_additive))[, 1],
  log_upper = suppressMessages(confint(m_additive))[, 2]
) %>%
  mutate(
    Multiplicative_effect = round(exp(log_estimate), 3),
    CI_95_lower           = round(exp(log_lower),   3),
    CI_95_upper           = round(exp(log_upper),   3)
  ) %>%
  filter(grepl("^period|^tidal_regime", Term)) %>%
  select(Term, Multiplicative_effect, CI_95_lower, CI_95_upper)

# Console summary
lrt_summary <- tibble(
  Test        = c("Period effect (controlling for regime)",
                  "Regime effect (controlling for period)"),
  df          = c(lrt_period$Df[2], lrt_regime$Df[2]),
  Chi_squared = round(c(lrt_period$Deviance[2], lrt_regime$Deviance[2]), 2),
  p_value     = vapply(
    c(lrt_period$`Pr(>Chi)`[2], lrt_regime$`Pr(>Chi)`[2]),
    function(p) if (is.na(p)) NA_character_
                else if (p < 0.0001) "<0.0001"
                else formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 4),
    character(1)
  ),
  Model = "Gamma GLM, log link"
)

print(lrt_summary)
message("\nMultiplicative effects (back-transformed from log scale) with 95% CIs:")
print(coef_table)
message("\nInterpretation:")
message("  - periodStorm:     Storm-period residence vs Pre-storm, controlling for regime")
message("  - periodPost-storm: Post-storm residence vs Pre-storm, controlling for regime")
message("  - tidal_regimeNeap: Neap residence vs Spring, controlling for period")
message("  Values > 1 indicate extension of residence time. CIs that include 1")
message("  indicate the effect is not significantly different from no effect.")
message("\n══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════\n")
```
